chunk.content: Red hybrid tilapia is valued partly because its colour resembles premium marine species such as sea bream (Pagrus major) and red snapper (Lutjanus argentimaculatus).
chunk.source_quote: Due to its characteristic colour resemblance to premium marine species such as the sea bream (Pagrus major (Temminck & Schlegel, 1843)) and red snapper (Lutjanus argentimaculatus
